name: Avalon Care Dental Practice
tagline: Dentistry that fits your life, not your schedule
heroSubtitle: Avalon Care Dental Practice in Levenshulme offers NHS and private care for adults and children, with text reminders and online booking so you're never left wondering when to show up.

usps.title: Patient-Centred Care
usps.description: Calm, supportive environment with sensory-aware care. We're committed to making every visit comfortable and stress-free for all patients.

usps.title: Accessible & Inclusive
usps.description: Wheelchair access to reception, toilets and three surgeries. We accommodate individual requirements and support initiatives like Autism Awareness Month.

usps.title: NHS & Cosmetic Options
usps.description: Choose between NHS dental care or cosmetic treatments including whitening, clear aligners and composite fillings, all tailored to your needs.

usps.title: Convenient Online Booking
usps.description: Book your appointment online with appointment reminders via text and email. Modern five-surgery practice in Levenshulme, Burnage area.

usps.title: GDC Registered Team
usps.description: All dentists, nurses and hygienist are registered with the General Dental Council. Continuous professional development ensures up-to-date care.

usps.title: Preventative Focus
usps.description: Evidence-based approach using 'Delivering Better Oral Health' toolkit. Early detection and long-term oral health promotion at the heart of our practice.

workflow.title: Book Your Appointment
workflow.description: Use our convenient online booking system or call our friendly reception team. Request a downstairs surgery if you have accessibility needs.

workflow.title: Initial Examination
workflow.description: Your dentist will conduct a comprehensive examination, take diagnostic X-rays if needed, and discuss any concerns about your oral health.

workflow.title: Personalised Treatment Plan
workflow.description: We'll create a tailored treatment plan based on your individual needs and goals, whether NHS or cosmetic care, with clear pricing.

workflow.title: Ongoing Care & Prevention
workflow.description: Receive your treatment with follow-up preventative advice, hygiene instruction and diet guidance to maintain long-term oral health.

faqs.question: What is the cost of an NHS dental examination?
faqs.answer: An NHS dental examination, diagnosis (including X-rays), simple scale if needed and preventative advice costs £27.90 (Band 1 charge as of April 2026). This also covers urgent treatment when you need to see a dentist immediately.

faqs.question: Do you offer cosmetic dental treatments?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a range of cosmetic treatments including professional teeth whitening from £350, composite white fillings from £149, and clear aligners. Our dentists will discuss all cosmetic options and provide a quotation tailored to your goals.

faqs.question: Are you accessible for patients with disabilities?
faqs.answer: Yes, our practice is fully accessible for disabled patients. We have wheelchair access to our reception area, toilets and three of our surgeries. We recommend requesting a downstairs surgery when you book your appointment.

faqs.question: Do you treat children?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide NHS dental care to children and offer special services including fluoride varnish application for children 3 years and over to help prevent tooth decay. Children under 18 are exempt from NHS dental charges.

faqs.question: Who is your hygienist and what do they specialise in?
faqs.answer: Faryal Shafique is our dedicated hygienist and a valued member of our dental team. She specialises in treating and guiding patients with periodontal diseases back to health. Hygienist visits cost £95.

faqs.question: What if I need multiple treatments?
faqs.answer: You only pay one NHS charge for your entire course of treatment, even if you need to visit multiple times. For example, a Band 2 charge (£76.60) covers all fillings and extractions needed as part of that course.

detailedServices.title: NHS Dental Examination & Diagnosis
detailedServices.description: Comprehensive examination, diagnosis including X-rays, simple scale if needed, and preventative advice. Covers urgent treatment when you need to see a dentist immediately.

detailedServices.title: NHS Fillings & Root Canal Treatment
detailedServices.description: Everything in Band 1 plus fillings, root canal work, and tooth extractions as needed. One charge covers your entire course of treatment.

detailedServices.title: NHS Crowns, Dentures & Bridges
detailedServices.description: Comprehensive prosthetic treatments including crowns, dentures and bridges. Includes all Band 1 and Band 2 treatments in one course charge.

detailedServices.title: Gum Health & Periodontal Treatment
detailedServices.description: Dedicated hygienist care for bleeding gums, bad breath and gum recession. Faryal Shafique, our specialist hygienist, treats and guides patients with periodontal diseases back to health.

detailedServices.title: Cosmetic Teeth Whitening
detailedServices.description: Professional home whitening treatment to brighten your smile. Our dentists will discuss cosmetic options tailored to your goals.

detailedServices.title: Oral Health Clinic & Hygiene Instruction
detailedServices.description: Specially trained nurse-led clinic offering up to 20 minutes of dedicated time for adults and children needing guidance with oral hygiene. Free for NHS patients. Includes fluoride varnish application for children 3+ to prevent tooth decay.

reviews.author: Sarah M.
reviews.text: The receptionists were friendly, respectful and accommodating when I rang to make my appointment. The whole team made me feel at ease. Highly recommend Avalon Care Dental Practice in Levenshulme.

reviews.author: James T.
reviews.text: Excellent NHS dental care. The dentist explained everything clearly and the hygienist's advice on gum health was really helpful. Very comfortable surgery and easy online booking.

reviews.author: Emma L.
reviews.text: Great experience at Avalon Care. The team was very patient with my child during his first visit. The fluoride varnish application was quick and painless. Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Michael K.
reviews.text: Professional and caring dentists. I had a filling done and the aftercare advice was thorough. The practice is accessible and the appointment reminders via text were really convenient.
